A '''beelpop melon''' was a purple-colored [[Melon/Legends|melon]] that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arkinnea]]. It was one of the ingredients for [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Zao]]'s cold melon soup.<ref name="FC2">[[Dark Times—Fire Carrier 2|''Dark Times—Fire Carrier'' 2]]</ref>
